name: Ötztaler Naturcamping
beschreibung: The Ötztaler Naturcamping is located in Längenfeld in the rear Ötztal in Tirol, surrounded by the mountains of the Ötztaler Alpen. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as sanitary facilities with showers and washing facilities. The surrounding area is accessible via nature and hiking trails that can be reached directly from the site. Nearby are the Aqua Dome leisure center as well as several ski areas, including the Sölden ski area within a short drive. Guests will find a quiet location here with views of the surrounding mountain landscapes and the Laugenbach. The site is suitable as a starting point for hiking, mountain biking tours and winter sports activities. The infrastructure of the town of Längenfeld with shops and dining options can be reached on foot or by car.
